tiebreakers.description: Turn order relative to first player

notes: Base competitive 2–4 players. End score: track + printed Alive values + 10 per achieved objective + dial VP + Captain-only highest positive humanity bonus (+5 each tied leader). The third tiebreak is turn order. Dial VP and body-part printed VP remain explicit component inputs; solo and Igor variant not modelled.
